title: From Interaction Traces to Persistent Skills: Online Evolution for Computer-Use Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.04869v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computer-use agents can execute increasingly complex tasks in graphical interfaces, but their interaction experience is typically transient: procedural knowledge acquired from one rollout is not systematically retained, refined, and reused in later tasks. Existing skill libraries provide external procedural knowledge, yet their incremental value over the same agent operating without skills, as well as their longitudinal dynamics under repeated interaction, remain insufficiently characterized. We present an online skill-evolution framework that converts interaction trajectories and evaluator feedback into a persistent, versioned library of reusable procedures. Each iteration executes against a frozen library snapshot, and evidence-guided skill updates become available in subsequent iterations without changing model parameters. We compare the full evolving-library system with a configuration-matched empty-library control across four OSWorl

translated_title: 从交互轨迹到持久技能：计算机使用智能体的在线演化
translated_abstract: 计算机使用智能体能够在图形界面中执行日益复杂的任务，但它们的交互经验通常是瞬态的：从一次执行中获得的过程性知识不会被系统地保留、提炼和重用于后续任务。现有的技能库提供了外部过程性知识，但其相对于同一智能体在无技能条件下运行的增量价值，以及在重复交互下的纵向动态特性，仍然缺乏充分的刻画。我们提出了一个在线技能演化框架，将交互轨迹和评估器反馈转化为一个持久的、版本化的可复用程序库。每次迭代都基于冻结的库快照执行，由证据引导的技能更新在后续迭代中可用，而无需更改模型参数。我们在四个OSWorld（环境）上比较了完整的演化库系统与配置匹配的空库对照组。
tldr: 该论文提出一个在线技能演化框架，将计算机使用智能体的交互轨迹与评估器反馈转化为持久、版本化的可复用技能库，在不改变模型参数的情况下使技能在后续任务中不断积累和演化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an online skill-evolution framework that converts computer-use agents' interaction trajectories and evaluator feedback into a persistent, versioned library of reusable skills, enabling skills to accumulate and evolve across subsequent tasks without changing model parameters.
